book_title: Cotton Dust in the South: A Laura Jensten Historical Mystery
author: John Marino
book_description: Cotton Dust in the SouthSavannah, 1922. The night hums with jazz and danger.When a triple murder rocks the city, reporter Laura Jensten follows a trail through the cotton mills,peakeasies, and smoke-filled rooms of the powerful.The deeper she digs with Jack Palmer, the darker it gets, and the more she realizes the real storyisn't in the paper. It's buried in the blood-soaked heart of the South.A haunting mystery of corruption, courage, and one woman's fight to be heard.Read the book that won't stay quiet. Uncover the truth. Before they bury it again, start reading now ... if you dare.Show more
